q: Bernoulli's equation, in fluid dynamics, relates the pressure, flow speed, and ____ for the steady (laminar) flow of an ideal incompressible fluid.
e: Bernoulli's equation, in fluid dynamics, relates the pressure, flow speed, and height for the steady (laminar) flow of an ideal incompressible fluid. Laminar flow moves in smooth layers with no mixing between neighbouring sheets.

q: The internal friction of the fluid flow is negligible (i.e. no ____).
e: The internal friction of the fluid flow is negligible (i.e. no viscosity). Viscosity is shear stress divided by velocity gradient, η = (F/A)/(dv/dy).

q: Bernoulli's equation can be derived using the ____ principle to a fluid flowing in a tube.
e: Bernoulli's equation can be derived using the work-energy principle to a fluid flowing in a tube. Bernoulli's equation keeps p + ½ρv² + ρgh constant along a streamline for incompressible, non-viscous laminar flow.

q: According to work-energy principle, the work done on this section of fluid must equal the change in total ____ energy (i.e. kinetic energy+potential energy).
e: According to work-energy principle, the work done on this section of fluid must equal the change in total mechanical energy (i.e. kinetic energy+potential energy). mechanical is the word that belongs in that blank.

q: The cross-sectional area, speed and ____ at two ends of the fluid section are $A_1$, $v_1$, $p_1$ and $A_2$, $v_2$, $p_2$, respectively.
e: The cross-sectional area, speed and pressure at two ends of the fluid section are A₁, v₁, p₁ and A₂, v₂, p₂, respectively. Along a streamline a speed rise is paid for by a pressure drop.

q: The work done on the fluid in this case is due to the ____ of the fluid.
e: The work done on the fluid in this case is due to the pressure of the fluid. Along a streamline a speed rise is paid for by a pressure drop.

q: In words, Bernoulli's theorem states that the sum of pressure energy, kinetic energy and potential energy per unit ____ of an incompressible, non-viscous fluid in a streamlined laminar flow remains constant.
e: The blank is volume. Volume flow rate Av is constant for an incompressible liquid in a pipe. That word is the one that completes the idea about words Bernoulli theorem states sum pressure.
